verdict.rationale: Otter has a Public API, but it is documented only as a prose help-center article with static examples. The evidence explicitly states that no machine-readable spec is published (api.otter.ai/openapi.json returns 404) and there is no interactive reference. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent features, not a downloadable OpenAPI-equivalent spec, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
